title: Session 9 direct-fetch admission evidence
capturedFrom: Direct session page-fetch observations at the per-entry URLs; short excerpts, not full archived bodies

entries.quote: San Diego County Registrar of Voters
entries.observation: The page identifies the county registrar and links the November 3, 2026 gubernatorial general election, candidate filing, voting options and election security.
The page links Previous Results at /data/election-results-archives, Data Central, Maps & GIS and the Election Library. Paid voter-data purchases are outside this project.
The County of Riverside page links November 3, 2026 General Election, June 2, 2026 Statewide Direct Primary Election, and November 4, 2025 Statewide Special Election.
The county registrar page links the November 3, 2026 election, offices up for election PDF, past elections and a voter-registration dashboard.
The page links Local Election Results at results.saccounty.gov, statewide results at electionresults.sos.ca.gov, and an Election Results - HTML service at eresults.saccounty.gov.
The county page links Official Election Results to its Santa_Clara Clarity host and offers View Election Results for contests and measures.
Reached through www.acvote.org redirect. The official site links CD14 Special Election Results Available for August 18, 2026 and county registration, ballot and maps resources.
Reached through www.sfelections.gov redirect. The page links Election results, downloadable election datasets and the June 25, 2026 certification announcement for the June 2 primary.

Reached through www.smcvote.org redirect. The page links November 3, 2026 Election and Candidate Information and the elections homepage, with a registrar@smcacre.gov contact. This is a calendar/candidate source, not a fetched result.
The page links the November election canvassing board administrative order and master schedule, important forms for elections, and candidate information. A schedule is not a certified result.

Reached through www.ocfelections.com redirect. The page offers the 2026 general election center with turnout updates and election-night results, and public canvassing-board and independent audit notices.

The page states the administration mission of impartial, accessible, secure and transparent voting and provides election and voter-registration information. Embedded social-media claims were not imported as election data.
The department page links Election Results & Reports, the November 3, 2026 General and Joint Election, sample ballots, and dated public logic-and-accuracy test notices.

The page lists August 11, April 7 and February 17 official results for 2026, with summary PDFs and detail files; 2024 entries separate federal/state and county results. Linked files were not individually validated here.
The page identifies the County Clerk office and links past Election Dates and Results, Ballot Information, and Election Auditing (ballot images and auditing reports).
The page identifies itself as an official Philadelphia government website and links 2026 Primary Election Results, the Citizens Handbook and election notices.
The official government page describes county election services and links current 2026 election information, elected officials, voter data and publications. No personal voter data was collected.
The county board page links the November 3 general election details, election-integrity information and polling-location changes. A current calendar is not a result or forecast.
The page links public Election Results at /results/, a November 2026 election calendar, and the 46-day notice. Individual voter lookup forms were not used.

The county page explicitly labels April 1, 2025 results UNOFFICIAL and Milwaukee County ONLY. It warns reporting units can reach 100% before central-count absentee ballots arrive, and election-day registration can produce ward participation above 100%. Not eligible as certified scoring truth.
